name: Pre-Applied Mathematics - BS
narrative: Students must complete all pre-major Mathematics courses with a 2.5 or higher UC grade-point average. All pre-major courses must be completed with a grade of “C” or better. Students seeking entry into the Applied Mathematics major must complete Computer Science 8, 9, 16 or Engineering 3 with a grade of “C” or better. Preparation courses are excluded from the pre-major GPA, but will apply to the overall major GPA. Entry into the pre-major does not guarantee admission to full major status. While completing required preparation, students are classified as a Pre-Math or Pre-Applied Math major

G.P.A. REQUIREMENTS At least 2.0 overall UC average in all upper-division major courses and all courses (Prep and UD) for the major.

sections.name: PREPARATION FOR THE MAJOR
sections.notes:
The following courses will NOT apply to any major in Mathematics: Math 100A-B, 193, 195A-B; PSTAT 109, 188, 190, 193.
Upon satisfactory completion of the pre-major requirements, the student must complete a change of major petition in the Department of Mathematics, 6607 South Hall, and obtain the appropriate signatures. At that time, the student must declare the specific major option of Applied Mathematics (B.S.) or Mathematics (B.A. or B.S.)
